title: Model inventory source v1
description: config/model/inventory/<id>.json (PADRAO-DEV F1): one place where requirements live before they are model objects. The inventory guard counts the distinct ids every source holds, so the chain measure cannot rise by leaving a source out.

id.description: The source id, equal to the file name.

parts.description: Ways to find the source's ids; the ids of all parts are unioned.

kind.description: content: distinct first groups of `pattern` in the files; filename: of `pattern` in the file names; files: one id per file; registry: one id per key of the owners' files.

pattern.description: A regular expression; its first group is the id.

becomes.description: The model types its entries may become when imported.
